headline: Approved Kristi Turgeon's three-year contract and a $385,000 Head Start grant; referred proposed student smart glasses rule to committee.
summary: Members approved the consent agenda, grants, and a three-year contract for the clerk. They approved reports on graduation requirements, facilities, and school boundaries. They referred a proposed smart glasses rule and a school choice policy review to Operations and Governance.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including minutes, donations, and personnel records, 9-0.
Approved the report on the new state graduation requirement and filed it, 9-0 by voice vote.
Approved the quarterly facilities report and held the item, 2-0 roll call vote.
Approved updates to three policies (ECAF, IHBG, and JFBB) and filed the item, 9-0.
Approved the district boundary and realignment report and held the item for future forums, 9-0.
Approved and filed the request on a gender support plan presented by DESE, 2-1 with Member Alvarez dissenting.
Approved a motion for more information on the gender support plan, to come in an upcoming Friday Letter.
Approved and filed the update on girls flag football at WPS, 3-0.
Approved and filed the review of common and statewide assessments and the K-12 assessment calendar request, 3-0.
Approved the Teaching, Learning, and Student Success report and filed it, 9-0.
Approved the FY27 Innovation Career Pathways grant, the $385,000 Head Start grant, the $5,000 UMass grant, and prior-year payments, 9-0.
Approved the response on GearUp Program funding and filed the item, 9-0 by voice vote.
Approved the response on purchasing the Cengage curriculum, not to exceed $1,500,000, and filed the item, 9-0.
Approved the response on a digital hall pass system and filed the item with two follow-up motions, 9-0.
Approved the report on expanding after school and athletics transportation and filed the item, 9-0.
Referred the proposed smart glasses and wearable technology rule to Operations and Governance, 9-0.
Approved the Resolution in Support of Head Start Programs and filed the item, 9-0 roll call vote.
Approved the easement to National Grid and filed the item, 9-0.
Approved the Italian-American Heritage and Culture Month recognition and filed the item, 9-0.
Approved the updated Report of the Superintendent schedule for 2026-27 and filed the item, 9-0.
Approved the Hispanic Heritage Month recognition and filed the item, 9-0.
Referred the review and update of the School Choice policy (JFBB) to Operations and Governance, 9-0.
Approved the employment contract for Kristi Turgeon as School Committee Executive Administrator and Clerk, 9-0.
Selected Member Kathleen Roy as the WPS delegate to the MASC/MASS Joint Conference, 8-0-1.
Selected Alex Guardiola as alternate WPS delegate to the MASC/MASS Joint Conference, 9-0.
